summary: @ornikar/webpack-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall running setup.mjs, which downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a tempdir, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the 727KB sibling math_init.js. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0xNNNN identifiers with string-indirection maps in setup.mjs; a shuffled string-array with rotation function and custom-alphabet decoder in math_init.js), so the executed behavior cannot be inspected statically. The alternate-runtime execution path means the payload never runs under Node, avoiding standard npm install-script visibility. package.json declares main: index.js but no index.js is present in the tarball; the package's advertised purpose (webpack configuration files) is not implemented by any shipped code, and the only executable content is the preinstall dropper chain. The package name is in the @ornikar scope but the shipped contents do not match a webpack-config library, consistent with a scope compromise or malicious impersonation used as cover for the install-time dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
